items.title: OpenAI Unveils GPT-5.6: A Leap in Frontier Intelligence and Efficiency
items.summary: OpenAI announced GPT-5.6, a new model that significantly advances both the intelligence and efficiency of its large language models, marking a major milestone in AI development.

items.title: Sam Altman and the Intensifying AI 'Decel' Debate
items.summary: TechCrunch reports on the ongoing and increasingly prominent debate around AI deceleration, highlighting Sam Altman's perspective and its implications for the future of AI development.

items.title: OpenAI Introduces ChatGPT for Academic Researchers to Accelerate Scientific Discovery
items.summary: OpenAI has launched a specialized version of ChatGPT aimed at academic researchers, designed to enhance and accelerate scientific discovery processes.

items.title: MPIE-Bench: A New Benchmark for Anatomically Plausible Multi-Person Interaction Editing
items.summary: Researchers introduce MPIE-Bench, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate the anatomical plausibility of AI models in editing multi-person interactions within visual data.

items.title: ACE-Data-0: Pioneering Human-Centric Ambient Capture for Embodied AI Data
items.summary: A new paper presents ACE-Data-0, a framework for human-centric ambient capture that serves as an embodied data engine, crucial for advancing realistic AI interactions.

items.title: OpenAI Showcases Avatarin's 24/7 Retail Agent Powered by GPT-Realtime
items.summary: OpenAI highlights Avatarin's successful implementation of a 24/7 retail agent, demonstrating the practical application and capabilities of GPT-Realtime in customer service.

items.title: Beyond Borrowed Histories: Person-Aligned User Simulation for Interactive Role-Playing Evaluation
items.summary: A new research paper explores person-aligned user simulation to improve the evaluation of interactive role-playing AI, moving beyond generic historical data.

items.title: Stratagems #21: AI's Misconceptions and the Reality of Progress
items.summary: This article delves into the critical examination of AI's perceived capabilities versus its actual state, questioning assumptions about its ongoing development and limitations.

items.title: RefCaptioner: Advancing Multi-Reference Image-Grounded Video Captioning
items.summary: RefCaptioner is introduced as a new method for generating video captions that are grounded in multiple reference images, improving the accuracy and richness of video descriptions.

items.title: β-OPSD: Policy Optimization and Self-Distillation for Deriving AI Models
items.summary: Researchers propose β-OPSD, a novel approach that combines policy optimization with self-distillation to efficiently derive and train AI models.

items.title: SpatialCLI: Learning to Reason with and without Spatial Tools for AI
items.summary: SpatialCLI explores how AI models can learn to reason effectively by initially using spatial tools and then generalizing to perform tasks without them.

items.title: I Built an Agent Eval Harness, But Real Agents Broke the Clean Story
items.summary: An engineer shares insights from building an agent evaluation harness, revealing how the unpredictable nature of real-world AI agents challenged initial assumptions and broke idealized test scenarios.

items.title: SpecFirst: Prioritizing Behavioral Specification in Agent-Based Program Synthesis
items.summary: SpecFirst proposes making behavioral specification a primary step in agent-based program synthesis, aiming to improve the reliability and clarity of AI-generated code.

items.title: ShadowDancer: Teaching Video World Models Any Action with Unified Dynamics Representations
items.summary: ShadowDancer introduces a method for teaching video world models to perform any action by learning unified dynamics representations from a video and its corresponding shadow.

items.title: Chimera: Designing and Chinchilla-Scaling Hybrid Visual Diffusion Transformers
items.summary: Chimera presents a new approach to designing and scaling hybrid visual diffusion transformers, leveraging the Chinchilla scaling laws for improved performance.
